questions.question: What were the total state tax collections for California in fiscal year 2023, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
california_col = header_row[header_row.str.contains('California', na=False)].index[0]
total_tax_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].str.contains('Total Taxes', na=False)].index[0]
result = int(df.iat[total_tax_row, california_col])

questions.question: In fiscal year 2023, which three states had the largest collections from severance taxes?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
states = header_row.iloc[3:].dropna()
sev_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].str.strip() == 'Severance'].iloc[0]

vals = {}
for col_idx, state_name in states.items():
    clean_name = ' '.join(str(state_name).split())
    if clean_name == 'DC':
        continue
    val = sev_row[col_idx]
    if pd.notna(val) and str(val).strip() != 'X':
        vals[clean_name] = float(val)

sorted_states = sorted(vals.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
result = [s[0] for s in sorted_states[:3]]

questions.question: In fiscal year 2023, did New York collect more in individual income taxes than in general sales and gross receipts taxes?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
ny_col = header_row[header_row.str.contains('New York', na=False)].index[0]

ind_inc_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].str.strip() == 'Individual income'].index[0]
gen_sales_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].str.strip() == 'General sales and gross receipts'].index[0]

ind_inc = float(df.iat[ind_inc_row, ny_col])
gen_sales = float(df.iat[gen_sales_row, ny_col])

result = 'yes' if ind_inc > gen_sales else 'no'

questions.question: How many states reported non-zero revenues from sports betting taxes in fiscal year 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
states = header_row.iloc[3:].dropna()

sports_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].str.contains('Sports betting', na=False)].iloc[0]

count = 0
for col_idx, state_name in states.items():
    clean_name = ' '.join(str(state_name).split())
    if clean_name == 'DC':
        continue
    val = sports_row[col_idx]
    if pd.notna(val) and str(val).strip() not in ['X', '']:
        if float(val) > 0:
            count += 1
result = count

questions.question: Across all 50 states, what was the average collection from hunting and fishing licenses in fiscal year 2023, in thousands of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
states = header_row.iloc[3:].dropna()

hunt_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].str.strip() == 'Hunting and fishing'].iloc[0]

vals = []
for col_idx, state_name in states.items():
    clean_name = ' '.join(str(state_name).split())
    if clean_name == 'DC':
        continue
    val = hunt_row[col_idx]
    if pd.notna(val) and str(val).strip() not in ['X', '']:
        vals.append(float(val))

result = round(sum(vals) / len(vals), 2)

questions.question: Which state collected the highest amount of motor fuel taxes in fiscal year 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_state_tax_collections_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Tax Collection 2023', header=None)
header_row = df.iloc[4]
states = header_row.iloc[3:].dropna()

motor_row = df[df.iloc[:, 0].str.strip() == 'Motor fuels'].iloc[0]

max_val = -1
max_state = None
for col_idx, state_name in states.items():
    clean_name = ' '.join(str(state_name).split())
    if clean_name == 'DC':
        continue
    val = motor_row[col_idx]
    if pd.notna(val) and str(val).strip() not in ['X', '']:
        val_float = float(val)
        if val_float > max_val:
            max_val = val_float
            max_state = clean_name

result = max_state
